title: Invertibility of strict-henselization cohomology comparison
statement: For a quasi-compact quasi-separated morphism f, geometric point xbar, abelian etale sheaf F and q : ℕ, the canonical strict-henselization cohomology comparison is an isomorphism.

proof.text: Unfold the canonical four-factor comparison. Its first, third and fourth factors are images or components of isomorphisms. Rewrite its middle factor using a private generic equality between the raw mapped mate and a transparent wrapper; this equality is proved by reflexivity with abstract categorical data. Transport the wrapper functors and adjunctions by equality induction and identify its square with the canonical square by congrArg on pullbackSquareComparison and proof irrelevance for CommSq. Apply strict-local global homology base change to F[0]. Three applications of IsIso.comp_isIso' combine the factors. All helpers are proved, all original definitions and signatures remain unchanged.

proof_origin.place: Tag 03Q9; four-factor canonical mate composition, with proof-local equality transport before projecting the mate
